name: Weaving
overview: Scripture reveals weaving as a skilled and purposeful craft integral to sacred service and daily life, exemplified by the finely woven garments made for Aaron and his sons, including the ephod and coats of fine linen (Exodus 28:32; 39:22, 27). The Lord endowed artisans like Bezaleel with wisdom to perform intricate weaving and embroidery in vibrant colors (Exodus 35:35). Additionally, weaving imagery appears in narratives such as Samson’s escape using the pin of the beam and web (Judges 16:14) and the description of a spear staff compared to a weaver's beam in battle (2 Samuel 21:19), highlighting the cultural significance and practical applications of weaving tools.
